description_for_human: Plugins de Claude Code y servidores MCP para operar una PyME en México. Aquí solo hay datos públicos en JSON.
description_for_model: Static JSON data about Plugins MX (https://github.com/elimorals/Skills_MX): 40 Claude Code plugins, 342 skills and 83 MCP servers (417 tools) for Mexican compliance (CFDI 4.0, SAT, payroll/IMSS, payments, marketplaces, state and municipal procedures). This site exposes no query API: the openapi only lists static catalogs (MCP real status, municipalities, 2026 ISN rates, REPSE facts). To run the MCPs, install the plugins in Claude Code (/plugin marketplace add elimorals/Skills_MX) or use each MCP's example.mcp.json with uv. Status on 2026-10-14: 24 real and validated live, 13 real without live validation (need credentials), 17 hand off to a human (CAPTCHA or login), 10 local normative calculations, 6 without public API, 2 blocked, 11 unverified.
